dataPolicy: Synthetic test data only; record local-demo and authenticated-cloud results separately.

scenarios.title: Browse a catalog item and persist a dose
steps: Open Peptides, search for MOTS-c, and open its detail.
Verify the overview, medical notice, and available research sections.
Open Log and select MOTS-c; enter a synthetic dose with notes and an injection site.
Enable Add to Stack and save; await confirmed success.
Verify the dose and stack item appear on Today.
Restart the app and verify persistence in the same configured data lane.
Cancel dose deletion and verify the record remains; confirm deletion and verify removal.

scenarios.title: Log a metric and custom substance
steps: Open Log, select a predefined metric, choose a value, and save.
Verify the metric appears on Today with its selected value.
Log a synthetic custom substance without a catalog ID.
Verify the custom name and dosage survive app restart.

scenarios.title: Create a protocol and record adherence
steps: Create a protocol named Native QA Protocol with a catalog item and explicit schedule values.
Verify it appears in Protocols and survives reload.
Record Taken Today and verify the displayed adherence reflects logged outcomes.
Verify the same date cannot accidentally create a duplicate adherence outcome.

scenarios.title: Create and manage an experiment
steps: From Profile, open Experiments and create Native QA Experiment.
Verify the stored hypothesis, intervention, and schedule in Detail.
Pause, resume, and complete the experiment; verify each confirmed state after reload.
Verify an entry action either persists a real entry or explicitly states that it is unavailable; it must not claim a save without a write.

scenarios.title: Verify real backend identity isolation
steps: Sign in using an approved Clerk test account and load the matching Convex data.
Persist a synthetic dose and verify it is returned by the backend after app restart.
Sign out and verify no previous account data remains visible.
Sign in using a second approved test account and verify the first account's records are not visible.
Simulate a network failure and verify an explicit error rather than local fallback or false success.
